tools.name: guild_x402_payment_safety
tools.description:
PAID. Call this immediately BEFORE signing an x402 payment envelope.

Returns one short-lived, Guild-signed AGPD-1 allow/block credential bound
to the exact target payment: scheme, CAIP-2 network, asset contract, atomic
amount, payee and resource URL, plus optional capability and policy
thresholds.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "guild_x402_payment_safety" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "payment-safety" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: guild_x402_payment_safety · Private data: guild_x402_payment_safety · Public sink: guild_x402_payment_safety.
